newsitem.title: THAILAND: Mitsubishi Gas Thai unit to invest $40 mln.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Gas Thai unit to invest $40 mln.

text.p: Thai Polyacetal Co Ltd, a Thai-Japanese joint venture firm, said on Monday it will invest about $40 million in doubling its production of polyacetal plastic pellets to 30,000 tonnes annually by 1999.

Thai Polyacetal, a joint venture between Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Co Inc and TOA Group, Thailand's major paint producer, said its second plant would be located on the same compound with the first plant in the Thai eastern province of Rayong.
Upon its completion, the company said it would export about 70 percent of production to countries in Asia and the Pacific while the remainder would be for consumption in Thailand.
Polyacetal plastic pellet is an essential raw material used in electronics and car industries.
The company's first plant, which has an annual production capacity of 15,000 tonnes, began production in April this year.
